If someone wanted to pick up this style of flute playing as a hobby, can anyone recommend a good bansuri to purchase? I'd kindly appreciate any assistance.

If you’d like to pick up this style as a hobby, we’d recommend starting with a good-quality Indian bamboo bansuri. 🌿

A C Natural Medium is generally easier for a complete beginner, while an A Natural Base gives a warmer, fuller tone without being too difficult to handle.

If you specifically prefer the deeper, softer and more meditative sound heard in this style of music, a G Natural Base bansuri would be a beautiful choice.

Whichever you choose, a well-tuned bamboo bansuri with comfortable finger spacing will make learning much more enjoyable. Wishing you a wonderful musical journey! 😊🎶
